title: lugarn-comms app ops v1
description: `lugarn-comms app <op>`: one JSON request on stdin, one JSON response on stdout. `watch` instead writes NDJSON watch lines until its input closes. Requests are discriminated by `op`; responses by `op` and `ok`; watch lines by `type`.

if_revision.description: The revision the app last saw. 0 creates the team and fails if it exists.

resume.description: true: members continue their current sessions and no tasks are posted. false (default): fresh sessions, initial tasks posted, last run's stopped spawned workers retired.

amount.description: How much to add. Default: the spec's hop_budget (hops) or review_rounds (rounds).

ttl_seconds.description: Hold (or renew the hold) for this long from now. The app renews it while the person is in control.

cancel_turn.description: false (default): wait for a running headless turn to end. true: cancel it.

paths.description: Exactly the worktrees to remove, as `worktrees` listed them.

protocol.description: The protocol chosen for this app: the highest in both lists.

capabilities.description: Feature flags. Known values are listed in docs/protocol.md; clients ignore ones they don't know.

logind.description: Linux with systemd-logind only; null elsewhere or when loginctl can't say.

events.description: Timeline events in ascending order. message.created items carry the message's current deliveries.

released.description: Held deliveries moved back to queued.

held_until.description: When the hold lapses; null once released.

released.description: Deliveries moved from held (person_control) back to queued by a release.

base.description: The ref the branch was created from: a branch name, or a commit if the base was detached.

merged.description: Whether the branch is merged into `base`. Null when the branch is gone.

started.description: false when the server was already running.

WatchLiveLine.description: Marks the end of the replay: every line after it is live.

WatchErrorLine.description: The last line of a watch that fails, including one whose request was invalid.

timeline.description: Whether this event is a timeline item.
